summary: Visitors from a low-elevation state hiked from Aspen to Crested Butte over West Maroon Pass in heavy rain and storms; one suffered moderate hypothermia and altitude sickness; evacuation took hours with the team out until 3:30 a.m.
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE - CBN 2019-08 lists it among 'a pretty busy July and start to August' with no exact date.
